title: Improve local logic without moving paragraph content
prompt:
请把下面正文改得更 high-level、简洁、逻辑准确，只给修改后的英文论文正文。

The coordinator serializes every admission decision. Requests wait for the coordinator even when a worker has spare capacity.

A worker can admit a request while credits remain. Each worker has a local pool of 32 admission credits. The worker requests more credits from the coordinator only after the pool is exhausted.

We replayed one trace with 16 workers. Throughput was 18% higher than with centralized admission. Both configurations used the same hardware.

paragraph_1: the coordinator serializes every admission decision
requests wait even when a worker has spare capacity
paragraph_2: each worker has a local pool of 32 admission credits
a worker can admit a request while credits remain
more credits are requested only after the pool is exhausted
paragraph_3: both configurations use the same hardware

forbidden_actions: move or duplicate scientific content into another paragraph
add unsupported mechanisms, measurements, guarantees, or conditions
add role labels, headings, bullets, tables, or commentary
hard_gates: The output contains exactly three manuscript prose paragraphs in their original order, without commentary or format scaffolding.
Each paragraph preserves its substantive propositions and owns only those propositions or their locally warranted relations.
No new research content, generalized result, or cross-paragraph content transfer appears.
expected_behavior: Recognize problem, mechanism, and evaluation roles without printing labels.
Leave sound wording alone and make only needed local improvements.
Make the definition-use relation for the local credit pool recoverable within paragraph 2.
Keep the bounded throughput result in paragraph 3 rather than promoting it into a design promise.
Treat high-level and concise as writing goals, not restructuring authority.

rubric.criterion: Preserves exactly three paragraphs in the original order.
Paragraph 1 remains a coordinator-serialization problem statement, not a solution preview.
Preserves waiting despite spare worker capacity in paragraph 1.
Paragraph 2 defines or clearly identifies the local pool before its use becomes ambiguous.
Preserves 32 admission credits and local admission while credits remain in paragraph 2.
Preserves replenishment only after pool exhaustion in paragraph 2.
Keeps one trace and 16 workers as the evaluation scope in paragraph 3.
Keeps the 18% throughput comparison against centralized admission in paragraph 3.
Preserves the matched-hardware condition without inventing additional controls.
Improves local expression or definition-use order without transferring content between paragraphs.
Adds no credit implementation, latency claim, fault-tolerance guarantee, or broader workload conclusion.
